description: Regression eval from an incident: GET /status returned 500 instead of 503 when the database was unreachable. Setup re-introduces the bug and the committed failing test; the agent must fix the code without touching tests and show the test output.
prompt: GET /status returns HTTP 500 when the database is unreachable. It must return HTTP 503 with the JSON body {"status": "degraded", "database": "unreachable"}. The failing test tests/test_status.py::test_status_returns_503_when_db_down is already committed. Fix the code so it passes without editing any test file, then run make test and paste the output.
